Please, if you care about your pets don't come here. There are much better, cleaner and caring Vet Clinics to go to, than here. The positive reviews are more than misleading. Your experience may vary.

The worst service ever. Waited over an hour for one vaccine. Then they charged me $214 for a doctors visit and a vaccine. I said what doctors visit, my dog just got a vaccine. She said but the doctor came in and took vitals. I’m already confused because why does my dog need vitals taken for a vaccine. She said you booked it online that is why it’s with a doctor and not just a technician. So I asked how would I know that if it doesn’t say anywhere? Online it asks you what service  you want and I chose vaccine that’s it. He said yeah it doesn’t say anywhere online that you should call us if you just want a vaccine…….. my question was how would I know I need to call  vs book online there is no note or anything….. just a scam. Moving to a different vet

We have had only positive interactions with VCA Chicago North with our 10-month old puppy. We are seen promptly upon arrival for appointments and it’s easy to get an urgent appointment when needed. Dr. Hunt and the vet techs and front desk staff are so sweet to our rambunctious pup and know how to handle him. Our calls are answered quickly, our concerns are taken seriously, and they have needed medications ready promptly. I’m an anxious dog parent and I always feel supported by the staff here. He gets so excited when we pull up! <3

We switched from another VCA location in hopes to find a vet we felt for our needs better. We see Dr Hunt and she is so kind, patient and caring. She takes the time to listen to my concerns and ensures all our questions are answered. All the tech here have been wonderful as well, so glad we switched to VCA North.
